text:
ben: Heads up — scheduling a proactive maintenance window in az4 this Thu 02:00-04:00 UTC. Reason: PSU phase-resync + NIC microcode. We'll do staggered drains across 4 cohorts to avoid full-pool outage. Target pool: saturn-gpu-7. Expected impact: ~10-15% capacity reduction per cohort, short KV-cache cold starts, possible +100-300ms tail for small gen requests. Call out any blockers by EOD today.

alice: can you quantify cost/backfill plan? if we spill into on-demand, ops budget needs a heads-up.

ben: short answer: if we backfill with spare reserved capacity -> minimal cost. If we pull on-demand for sustained 90m per cohort, estimate ~$3k-$6k window depending on how many cohorts hit at once. We'll prefer reserved spares and spot where safe; only fallback to on-demand if SLA routes are starved. We'll tag all usage to project:eng-maint.

carla: KV cache concern — when we cordon+drain nodes we lose local prefixes. propose pre-seed KV on standby nodes 30m before cohort drain. script below worked in dry-run: 
```bash
# preseed kvcache to warm fallback cohort
python infra/tools/kv_preseed.py --pool saturn-gpu-7 --cohort 3 --prefixes /deploy/heatmap-prompts.json
```
I can run the preseed job if ops approves.

dave: what about model routing? if latencies spike we should route to smaller quantized model automatically. who owns route policy?

ben: routing policy handled by route-svc team; plan: set a short-latency fallback for routes /generate and /chat-rt to quantized variants (q2) during the window. fallback will be on for cohorts marked as draining. I'll open a quick PR to the route-svc config and request a canary rollout.

raj: thumbs up on preseed. only ask: avoid starting cohort 1 at 02:00 if it overlaps APAC peak for a partner ingest job — can we shift cohort sequence by 15m?

ben: yes — we can shift sequence +15m for cohort 1. updated plan: cohorts start at 02:00, 02:45, 03:30, 04:15 (cohort windows overlap slightly but we keep max reduced cap under 20%). documenting this in the runbook now.

ops-bot: Maintenance ticket created: INC-2026-3149. Pager schedule: oncall-eng (ben) primary, oncall-net (carla) secondary. Notifications will be sent 60m/15m/5m before start.

alice: can we expect any customer-visible errors or 429s? need to tell support/trust if so.

ben: low likelihood of 429s for hosted API because of autoscaling + backfill policies; possible transient 503s for long-running streaming sessions during eviction. mitigation: automatic retry with jitter on SDKs + route fallback to q2. I'll add a short note to the status page draft.

carla: I'll take responsibility for preseed job and run net sanity checks pre/post cohort. I'll also watch NIC error counters and BGP flaps.

dave: will there be any manual bailout criteria?

ben: yes — if p95 latency on /generate increases by >350ms for 3 consecutive 1-min buckets OR error rate >0.75% for 5m we abort and rollback drains. Abort steps are in runbook (quick uncordon + prioritize KV replication).

raj: no objections from infra-ml side. please ensure dedicated tenants for enterprise customers are excluded from spot backfill.

ben: agreed — enterprise-dedicated pools are excluded. tagging and policy in place.

carla: preseed script attached to the runbook. I'll queue it for a 30m warmup.

ben: thanks team. final ask: thumbs up in thread if you can be available during window. I'll post the final schedule and runbook link in 1h. :thumbsup:
